description: WHOIS / RDAP domain lookup: give a domain, get registrar, registration (creation), expiry and last-updated dates, status codes and nameservers from the registry's RDAP service, plus DNS records and SPF/DMARC/DKIM email-auth posture. Use to check a domain's age, registrar or expiry before trusting a merchant, vendor or counterparty. No personal data. Signed receipt. Price: $0.003 per call via x402 (USDC on Base or XRP on XRPL). The response includes a `provenance` block (sg-provenance/1): each fact carries its source, source URL, retrieval time and limits; evidence only, no score, rating or verdict. Example arguments: {"domain":"example.com"}.
name: whois

outputSchema.description: Paid result: { data, receipt }. Unpaid calls return an x402 PaymentRequired object instead (isError: true).

data.description: Registry RDAP registrar, creation/expiry/update dates, status and nameservers, plus DNS and email-auth facts

provenance.description: The response includes a `provenance` block (sg-provenance/1): each fact carries its source, source URL, retrieval time and limits; evidence only, no score, rating or verdict.

receipt.description: Ed25519-signed, hash-chained receipt; verify free with the verify_receipt tool or POST /v1/verify-receipt. New receipts carry a signed `evidence` object: service_version, data_timestamp, validation, terms_version, terms_hash, provenance_hash.

title: WHOIS RDAP Domain Lookup
